name: CLM_CVG_INFO
description: This table stores claim level coverage related information.

columns.name: CLAIM_PRINT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the Claim Info record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: AUTH_NUM
columns.description: Stores the authorization number for the corresponding coverage.

columns.name: AUTH_TYP_C_NAME
columns.description: Store the authorization type for the corresponding coverage.

columns.name: AUTH_SOURCE_REFERRAL_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the referral or auth/cert record when the authorization number on the row was found in the referral or auth/cert.

columns.name: AUTH_SOURCE_AUTH_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the service level authorization record when the authorization number on the row was found in the authorization record.

columns.name: AUTH_SOURCE_HSP_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the hospital account when the authorization number on the row was found in the account.

columns.name: AUTH_SOURCE_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the hospital account when the authorization number on the row was found in the account.

columns.name: AUTH_NUM_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The auth number search precedence category ID identifying where the authorization number was found.

columns.name: AUTH_PB_RFL_RECORD_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Professional Billing referral source search precedence category ID identifying where the source referral or auth/cert record was found.

columns.name: AUTH_HB_RFL_RECORD_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Hospital Billing referral source search precedence category ID identifying where the source referral or auth/cert record was found.
